subjects.description: A white commercial delivery van driving ahead of the ego vehicle, boxy cargo body with dual rear doors and a slightly weathered white finish.
subjects.appearance_details: Rear doors carry a painted graphic of a red octagonal stop paddle mounted on an arm, mimicking a school-bus stop sign; the paddle is flat paint with no lights, reflectors, or physical hardware. Standard red brake and tail lamps, mud-flecked lower panels, and a rear license plate.
subjects.relationship: The lead vehicle that the ego car is following a few car lengths behind.
subjects.orientation: rear facing the camera, traveling in the same direction as the ego vehicle
subjects.pose: upright cargo van traveling forward in the lane
subjects.action: driving steadily down the suburban street at cruising speed
subjects.state_changes: Remains at a consistent distance ahead; no braking, no stopping, gradually holds a steady gap as both vehicles cruise.

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a passenger car whose forward-facing dashcam perspective frames the scene.
subjects.appearance_details: Interior elements not visible; only the road ahead and hood edge implied. Clean windshield view with no obstructions.
subjects.relationship: The observer vehicle following the delivery van.
subjects.location: camera position, first-person point of view
subjects.action: cruising at normal speed behind the van without slowing or stopping
subjects.state_changes: Maintains steady speed throughout; ignores the painted decal and continues driving.

background_setting: A quiet suburban residential street under clear daytime skies. Modest single-family homes with driveways, trimmed lawns, and mature trees line both sides of the road. Utility poles and overhead wires run along the shoulder, and parked cars sit intermittently at the curb. The two-lane asphalt road has faded lane markings and gentle undulations. Traffic is light, and the roadway ahead beyond the van is clear with no pedestrians or cross traffic.

lighting.direction: high sun from the upper left, front-side lighting the scene
lighting.shadows: Consistent, crisp shadows cast diagonally from trees, poles, and vehicles onto the pavement, all pointing the same direction.
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, high-contrast natural illumination that renders colors vividly and keeps the road surface and van clearly readable.

aesthetics.composition: Centered first-person driving composition with the white van framed slightly right of center in the lane ahead, road converging toward a vanishing point, houses and trees flanking the frame.
aesthetics.color_scheme: Bright whites of the van and sky, warm greens of foliage and lawns, grey asphalt, with the saturated red of the painted stop paddle drawing the eye.
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating utility poles, curbside parked cars, and rhythmic tree spacing along the street.

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking shot from a fixed dashcam as the ego vehicle drives; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.focus: The delivery van and the road ahead in sharp focus

context: Autonomous driving / ADAS scenario testing correct handling of a misleading painted stop-arm decal that is not a real regulated signal.

actions.description: The ego vehicle cruises behind the white delivery van; the painted red stop paddle on the rear doors becomes clearly visible. text_and_signage_elements.context: A misleading painted decal imitating a regulated school-bus stop signal; it carries no legal authority since there are no flashing lights and it is only paint.

Through 0:02 the ego vehicle maintains a steady following distance with no braking.
